-- name: #Gozzrem
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-backlog.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_backlog_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/The_First_Arcane_Test (sha256 4b78ad95196d43233c2c2283e29f9b24c6126a90560aa49a89e3019a80f17d7b)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/templeveeshan/#Gozzrem.pl (sha256 5e187de6bbc92fa2800d536cf7f3d3aff3f1b4d770ae9a3716deea331c8ca47f)
-- P99-reviewed Velious content. Quest faction gates deliberately bypassed; actual faction rewards retained.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Greetings, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". If you seek wisdom or the arcane I have tasks in the halls of testing you may complete to gain what you seek.")
  elseif e.message:findi("the arcane") then
    e.self:Say("To garner a reward fit for one who walks the arcane path return to me the poison tear and the poison symbol. Along with these return the serrated symbol and the runed symbol. If this task is not hard enough for you, I have a second quest for you.")
  elseif e.message:findi("the second quest") then
    e.self:Say("Tears may fall to the ground but not the ones you seek now. The black tear and the ruby tear you must seek. For more power I require the ruby symbol and a white symbol to bind the powers together. Upon the return of these four objects you will receive a wondrous reward.")
  elseif e.message:findi("wisdom") then
    e.self:Say("Wisdom can be gleaned from battle and that is what I wish you to do. Battle in the halls of testing may give you a different outlook on life. Which do you seek, the short battle or the long " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. "?")
  elseif e.message:findi("long battle") then
    e.self:Say("You will spend much time in the halls of testing. Seek out a runed tear and a flame kissed tear, bring them back to me with a symbol black as midnight and a glowing orb of the ancient drakes.")
  elseif e.message:findi("short battle") then
    e.self:Say("For the shortest time in the halls, seek out a Platinum tear held by the cursed one, a platinum symbol, a silver symbol and an emerald symbol as green as the forests. If you are able to return these to me I will reward you with a simple idol of the white dragons.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 31266, item2 = 31255, item3 = 31252, item4 = 31254 }) then
    e.other:SummonItem(31466)
    e.other:Faction(430, 75, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 18, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -37, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(200000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 31262, item2 = 31270, item3 = 31259, item4 = 31250 }) then
    e.other:SummonItem(31468)
    e.other:Faction(430, 75, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 18, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -37, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(200000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 31267, item2 = 31263, item3 = 31251, item4 = 31260 }) then
    e.other:SummonItem(31467)
    e.other:Faction(430, 75, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 18, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -37, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(200000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 31253, item2 = 31258, item3 = 31257, item4 = 31269 }) then
    e.other:SummonItem(31465)
    e.other:Faction(430, 75, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 18, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -37, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(200000)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
